text: PR #5464 (#5424 dedupe) merged as v1-development, issue #5424 closed. Full saga: extracted read_open_object_with_identity_recheck() shared between read_physically_contained_file_snapshot_from_handle() and read_physically_contained_file_snapshot(), collapsing 4 near-identical 64KB read-loop-plus-identity-recheck blocks into 1, preserving both callers' pre-existing behavioral differences (content_equal vs full identity comparison; the Windows-only read_failed-vs-indirect_component info-query-failure discrepancy) via explicit parameters. Two real findings fixed before merge, both the same class of bug (accidentally widening that Windows-only discrepancy to POSIX): one caught during implementation and fixed pre-emptively, one caught live by Codex bot review on the PR (commit 1926fefee) after the first push shipped it anyway -- replied and resolved. Also hit and worked around a DCO/branch-update gotcha (see 6c916a5c below, folded into this same batch): gh api -X PUT .../update-branch creates an unsigned merge commit that fails DCO Sign-Off even when every real commit is properly signed off; fixed by rebasing locally + force-push instead, needed twice as #5465/#5466/#5467 (small channel-status PRs) merged into v1-development while #5464's CI was still running each time.
